decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch closely related to the firm's established fabricated solutions for fluid-handling applications, it is recent enough and strategically consistent enough that management is likely to continue backing it rather than admit a premature mistake.

Public waste bins are comparatively distant from the firm's core offer, so despite the recent website commitment the firm has less strategic and technical reason to defend the product if early traction is uncertain.
Ground sleeves fit the firm's metal fabrication capabilities and market broadening path, so escalation of commitment makes management likely to persist with this new but related product line.

Cast iron ground sleeves build on existing fabrication know-how and appear part of a broader sleeves family, increasing management's willingness to keep supporting the launch after committing it publicly.

Steel ground sleeves are close to the firm's materials expertise and to the other newly launched sleeve variants, so management is likely to continue rather than write off the development and market introduction effort.
